questions.q: Given that $x > 0$ and $y < 0$, compare: Column A: $x - y$, Column B: $y - x$.
choices: Value in Column A is greater
Value in Column B is greater

questions.answer: Since $x > 0$ and $y < 0$, $x - y$ is positive minus negative, which is strictly positive ($> 0$). Conversely, $y - x$ is negative minus positive, which is strictly negative ($< 0$). Thus, Column A is greater.

questions.answer: Third angle $\angle C = 180 - (50 + 70) = 60^\circ$. Side $AB$ is opposite $\angle C = 60^\circ$. Side $AC$ is opposite $\angle B = 70^\circ$. In any triangle, larger angles face longer sides. Thus, $AC > AB$.
